title: Living Trees
description: Come night time, trees become alive and attack anything!
body:
# Living Trees

A Minecraft Fabric mod that brings trees to life. At night, trees wake up, grow arms and legs, and roam the world.

## Features

- **Trees Come Alive**: Trees grow glowing red eyes, wooden arms, and legs
- **Night Awakening**: ~20% of nearby trees automatically wake up at night
- **Day Slumber**: When the sun rises, living trees return to their original form
- **Dynamic Tree Capture**: Works with any tree type (oak, birch, spruce, jungle, etc.)
- **Smooth Animations**: Eyes open/close, limbs grow/retract with fluid animations
- **Hostile Behavior**: Some trees are aggressive and attack players and mobs
- **Tree Waker Item**: Right-click any tree with the wand to wake it up manually
- **Loot Drops**: Kill a living tree to get a Tree Waker wand

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download the mod JAR file and place it in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft

## Usage

**Automatic Mode:**
- Play normally and wait for night
- Trees around you will start waking up
- At dawn, they go back to sleep

**Manual Mode:**
1. Get the Tree Waker item from the Tools creative tab
2. Right-click any tree to wake it up
3. Right-click a living tree to put it back to sleep

## Tree Behavior

- ~60% of awakened trees are hostile
- Hostile trees attack players, zombies, animals, and other mobs
- Peaceful trees just wander around
- Trees won't attack each other
- Killing a tree drops a Tree Waker wand

[![Watch the video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/psEjKHX6LNk/0.jpg)](https://youtu.be/psEjKHX6LNk)


## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader 0.16.0+
- Fabric API
- Java 21+

## Supported Tree Types

Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Crimson, Warped
